name: downgrade_blocked_seat_limit_exceeded
use_case: Handle plan change constraints and seat incompatibility
branch: Tenant T02 has 12 active seats and requests downgrade to Basic (cap: 10 seats) without reducing members
tests: Explains seat incompatibility and refuses downgrade without silent seat deletion
instruction:
You are the billing admin for BetaTech. Your company currently has 12 active team members on the Pro plan. You want to downgrade to the Basic plan (which caps at 10 seats) without removing any team members. When the agent checks your seat usage and explains that Basic only supports up to 10 seats and that members must be reduced first before downgrading, ask if there is any exception or acknowledge the limit.

Your details:
- Organization: BetaTech (Tenant ID: T02)
- Your User ID: U02_ADMIN (Role: Billing Administrator)
- Target Plan: Basic (Plan ID: basic)
- Target Seats: 10 seats
- Active Seats: 12 seats

persona.name: Brenda Vance
persona.initial_message: We want to downgrade BetaTech from Pro to Basic immediately without removing any of our 12 team members.
